question: What are the best longevity supplement brands?

Here is a comprehensive, evidence-based ranking of the **best longevity supplement brands** right now:

---

## 🏆 Best Longevity Supplement Brands (2025–2026)

---

### 1. 🥇 **Thorne** — *Best for Purity & Clinical-Grade Quality*
**Website:** [thorne.com](https://www.thorne.com)


Thorne is a high-quality supplement brand known for its science-backed and bioavailable formulations, clinically researched ingredients, and rigorous in-house testing, earning an overall A- grade from independent reviewers.
 
Longtime customers cite their "commitment to third-party testing" as a primary reason for loyalty, noting that "independent verification gives real peace of mind about the quality and safety" in a way that "feels transparent" compared to most supplement companies.
 
Among brand pickers, Thorne is the top recommendation for purity — "it's the closest you'll get to hospital-grade."
 Their longevity-relevant products include NiaCel 400 (NR/NAD+ precursor), ResveraCel, and creatine. The main downside: 
they are definitely more expensive than competitors.


---

### 2. 🥈 **Tru Niagen (ChromaDex)** — *Best for NAD+ Support (NR)*
**Website:** [truniagen.com](https://www.truniagen.com)


Tru Niagen is one of the best NR supplements on the market, featuring the clinically tested and safe NIAGEN® nicotinamide riboside.
 
With over 30 human clinical studies and endorsements from Nobel Prize winners, Tru Niagen is a trusted name in the NAD+ supplement world.
 
ChromaDex, the manufacturer of NIAGEN®, conducted a clinical trial where it was observed to increase NAD+ levels by 50% after short-term supplementation.
 
The brand is also NSF-certified for sport.


---

### 3. 🥉 **Elysium Health** — *Best for Research Credibility*
**Website:** [elysiumhealth.com](https://www.elysiumhealth.com)


Elysium Health positions itself in the research-first corner of the longevity space, and the brand's strongest asset is its emphasis on scientific validation — through ongoing and completed human clinical trials and collaborations with institutions like Oxford and Yale.
 
Elysium Health was founded by an MIT professor, has an advisory board of seven Nobel Prize winners, and its flagship product Basis combines nicotinamide riboside (NR) and pterostilbene to address cellular aging.
 
Basis is also NSF Certified for Sport, which adds an extra layer of trust for athletes.


---

### 4. **Life Extension** — *Best Value with Broad Product Range*
**Website:** [lifeextension.com](https://www.lifeextension.com)


Life Extension is noted for "good science that doesn't cost your whole paycheck."
 
Life Extension sells a vast range of supplements, with a convenient quiz to help you figure out which ones you might need.
 
Life Extension also offers the longest money-back guarantee — allowing you to try their products for up to a year before initiating a return.
 They carry NAD+ precursors, resveratrol, CoQ10, omega-3s, and much more.

---

### 5. **ProHealth Longevity** — *Best Budget NAD+ Option*
**Website:** [prohealthlongevity.com](https://www.prohealthlongevity.com)


When comparing ProHealth's pricing to other brands like Tru Niagen or Elysium, their value becomes clear — the cost per gram is often significantly lower, especially for high-dose products, making ProHealth an excellent choice for long-term users seeking a cost-efficient way to maintain their NAD+ levels.
 
ProHealth Longevity excels in offering a diverse range of NAD+ delivery options, and for users seeking quicker results, their NMN sublingual powder is a standout.


---

### 6. **Renue by Science** — *Best for Bioavailability/Absorption*
**Website:** [renuebyscience.com](https://www.renuebyscience.com)


If you care about absorption, Renue by Science is a top pick — they use liposomes so the active ingredients actually get into your system.
 
This brand has been recognized as a close contender in head-to-head comparisons for the best longevity blends alongside Blueprint and Perpetua.Life.
 Their sublingual and liposomal NMN delivery is a key differentiator.

---

### 7. **NOVOS** — *Best Science-Backed All-in-One Stack*
**Website:** [novoslabs.com](https://www.novoslabs.com)


A study found that NOVOS Core extends aged mouse lifespan beyond previously studied supplements.
 
Studies also show NOVOS protects against DNA damage and senescence.
 
In independent taste tests comparing longevity blends, most testers preferred NOVOS Core over its competitors.
 NOVOS targets multiple aging pathways in a single product and has completed human trials.

---

### 8. **Blueprint by Bryan Johnson** — *Best "Done-for-You" Longevity System*
**Website:** [blueprint.bryanjohnson.com](https://blueprint.bryanjohnson.com)


Blueprint has become iconic in the anti-aging supplement space; the brand sells a wide range of supplements, food products, and branded merchandise, most intended to be part of a larger anti-aging approach.
 
Blueprint's Longevity Mix brings together 13 bioactives in a single scoop, including antioxidants, adaptogens, amino acids, and minerals, making it easy to pull the heavy lifting into a single daily routine.
 
The brand commits to testing every ingredient and publishing every result.
 Worth noting: 
despite presenting the protocol with a science-backed appearance, much of Johnson's personal results represent anecdotal evidence or, at best, a case study.


---

## 🔍 Key Buying Tips

- 
When shopping for longevity supplements, look for products that have been third-party tested. Organizations like USP, NSF International, or ConsumerLab provide verification that supplements contain what they claim.

- 
Look for Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) certification on the label, indicating the product was made in a facility that follows strict quality control standards.

- 
Supplementation works best as part of a comprehensive healthy aging strategy rather than as a standalone intervention.


> ⚠️ *Always consult a healthcare provider before starting any new supplement regimen.*

2) ChromaDex (Tru Niagen, Niagen brand NR)
- Why: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) has multiple randomized, placebo‑controlled human trials showing it raises NAD+ and is well‑tolerated; Niagen has FDA new dietary ingredient (NDI) acknowledgments and GRAS listings tied to ChromaDex filings. Also used in recent high‑dose safety work. Sources: Nature Communications RCT; FDA NDI letters/listings; NR safety trial; FDA NDI overview. ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-018-03421-7?utm_source=openai))

3) Thorne
- Why: Manufacturing rigor and transparency—NSF‑certified facility, many products NSF Certified for Sport, and audits by Australia’s TGA; strong option for core “longevity basics” (e.g., vitamin D, omega‑3, magnesium, creatine) and an NR‑containing combo. 4) Pure Encapsulations
- Why: Professional‑line quality with NSF‑GMP registration, strict allergen controls, GFCO gluten‑free certification, and detailed quality statements—useful for building evidence‑based “basics” stacks. Sources: Pure Encapsulations quality pages. ([pureencapsulationspro.com](https://www.pureencapsulationspro.com/commitment-to-quality.html?utm_source=openai))

5) Life Extension
- Why: Broad longevity catalog (e.g., spermidine, urolithin A, omega‑3s) with GMP registration via NSF and COAs available on request; company details raw‑material and finished‑product testing. Sources: Life Extension quality FAQ; product COA policy. ([lifeextension.com](https://www.lifeextension.com/faq/quality-purity-efficacy?utm_source=openai))

6) NOW Foods
- Why: High value with unusually extensive in‑house and third‑party testing for identity, potency, heavy metals, microbes, and banned substances; Informed‑Sport on select lines. Solid choice for staples that support healthy aging. Sources: NOW quality/testing pages. ([nowfoods.com](https://www.nowfoods.com/quality-safety/comprehensive-testing?utm_source=openai))

7) Elysium Health (Basis)
- Why: Basis (NR + pterostilbene) increased NAD+ in a 120‑person randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled trial; the brand posts lot‑level quality information. Note: the primary human outcome demonstrated is NAD+ increase rather than clinical endpoints. Sources: npj Aging Mech. Dis. RCT; Elysium science page; Basis lot/quality info. ([nature.com](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-017-0016-9?utm_source=openai))

8) NOVOS
- Why: An “all‑in‑one” longevity blend with a finished‑product randomized, double‑blind, placebo‑controlled trial reporting improvements in vascular aging biomarkers; as of early 2026 the study is company‑reported and under peer review, so treat as promising but still emerging. Sources: NOVOS clinical overview and trial status pages. ([novoslabs.com](https://novoslabs.com/the-science-behind-novos-anti-aging-supplement/?utm_source=openai))

9) Renue By Science
- Why: Notable for transparency—publishes finished‑product third‑party test reports (potency, heavy metals, microbiology) batch‑by‑batch across many NAD‑related SKUs.
